object-entries.description: This expert agent answers requests about art, such as painting, drawing, sculpture, art history, or creative techniques, in no more than 3 sentences, extracting the parameter 'request'.

This editing agent rewrites an existing story the user provides so it better fits a target audience, extracting the parameters 'story' (the full story text) and 'audience' (for example 'young adults' or 'children').

This writing agent drafts a short story (no more than 3 sentences) around a given topic; use it only when the user asks for a story draft on a topic without asking to adapt it to an audience or style, extracting the parameter 'topic'.
This expert agent answers requests about legal matters, such as contracts, rights, disputes, or regulations, in no more than 3 sentences, extracting the parameter 'request'.
This expert agent answers requests about health and medicine, such as injuries, symptoms, or treatments, in no more than 3 sentences, extracting the parameter 'request'.
This agent analyzes a request and classifies the expertise needed to answer it, returning exactly one of 'medical', 'legal', or 'art', extracting the parameter 'request'.

This editing agent rewrites an existing story the user provides so it is more coherent with a given style or genre, extracting the parameters 'story' (the full story text) and 'style' (for example 'fantasy' or 'noir').

This reviewing agent scores how well a story aligns with a given style, returning only a score between 0.0 and 1.0, extracting the parameters 'story' (the full story text) and 'style' (for example 'noir' or 'pirate speak').
